title: 4 Hour Sunset Seasonal Tarpon Charter from Key West
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
On your 4-hour sunset tarpon charter, we’ll focus on targeting migrating tarpon during one of the most active feeding windows of the day. Sunset is prime time to hook into these powerful fish, and there’s often a chance to catch bonus dinner species along the way. This seasonal trip runs from April 20 to June 20 and offers a short but incredible window to connect with the fish of a lifetime.

We are especially passionate about tarpon fishing—chasing these giants is what we look forward to all year. With a limit of four anglers, you'll have the space, attention, and strategy you need to make every shot count. From dialing in your presentation to managing long, high-adrenaline fights, this trip is all about making the most of a brief and unforgettable season on the water.
